### Methods

#### ShouldMergeWithPreviousPage

```text
public System.Boolean ShouldMergeWithPreviousPage(System.Guid firstParentId)
```

Determines whether the first record on a new page should be merged with the last parent from the previous page, rather than treated as a new parent. This occurs when a parent record&#x27;s child rows span a page boundary.

- Parameter `firstParentId`: The primary key of the first parent record on the new page.

Returns: true if the record is a continuation of a parent from the previous page and its child records should be merged; false otherwise.

#### SetLastParentId

```text
public System.Void SetLastParentId(System.Guid parentId)
```

Records the primary key of the last parent record on the current page. Called at the end of each page when P:PPDS.Dataverse.Query.Planning.Nodes.FetchXmlScanNode.HasLinkedEntity is true to enable boundary split detection on the next page.

- Parameter `parentId`: The primary key of the last parent record on the current page.

#### AutoPage

```text
System.Boolean AutoPage { get; }
```

If true, automatically fetch all pages. If false, single page only.


#### HasLinkedEntity

```text
System.Boolean HasLinkedEntity { get; }
```

Indicates whether the FetchXML query contains link-entity elements. When true, pagination may split a parent record&#x27;s children across page boundaries, requiring merge logic to avoid duplicate parents with incomplete child sets.
